description: Rust Boil rebuild after wave5d went 0/8 (arms 8/8 — 'heaves' + action poses anthropomorphized it into a hunched figure, Forbidden-adjacent; spout literalized as pipe/funnel/horn with the lantern hung off it; slurry rendered as crimson blood). Fixes: tallow-light prefix; limbless blister-dome language; vent pose REPLACED with a second idle composition (action poses come later in production via the LoRA); crown-hole sealed under a stretched tallow disc; dried rust-brown stains, no flowing gore. Fresh seeds.
style_prefix: hand-painted oil-and-ink creature concept art, muted peat-and-tallow palette, soft charcoal outlines, one warm tallow light in cold fen gloom, grim folkloric, matte painterly texture

subjects.prompt: a Rust Boil, a completely limbless swollen dome of dark peat-flesh like a giant sealed blister half-sunk in shallow black bog water at a three-quarter angle, smooth heavy sides with no arms and no legs, a single round hole at its crown sealed under a thick stretched disc of translucent amber tallow, old dried dark rust-brown stain trails running down from the crown rim, one yellow-brown fen-bone splinter jutting sideways from its flank, colours peat black-brown, dried rust, tallow gold, a single creature, pale misty background

a Rust Boil straining under inner pressure, a limbless swollen blister-dome of dark peat-flesh half-sunk in the shallows, the thick stretched disc of amber tallow sealing its crown-hole bulging upward and stretched thin with a faint warm glow through the strained wax, old dried rust-brown stains layered down its smooth flanks, the fen-bone splinter in its side catching warm light, colours peat black-brown, dried rust, tallow gold, a single creature, dark misty background

a Rust Boil settled against a low peat bank, a heavy limbless swollen dome of dark peat-flesh sitting like a sealed blister among broken reeds, the round crown-hole capped with its thick stretched amber tallow disc, wide dried dark rust-brown stains fanning down one smooth flank, a single yellow-brown fen-bone splinter jutting from its side, still black water around its base, colours peat black-brown, dried rust, tallow gold, a single creature, pale misty background

a Rust Boil in full profile in shallow bog water, a smooth heavy limbless mound of dark swollen peat-flesh with one raised round crown-hole sealed under thick stretched amber tallow, layered old dried rust-brown stains running down its near flank, one yellow-brown fen-bone splinter jutting from its side, slow ripples around its half-sunk base, colours peat black-brown, dried rust, tallow gold, a single creature, dark misty background
